caption: Rendering cost per 1280×720 frame on the 4-core Xeon box (no GPU), measured on the 1000-sphere test trajectory including overlay and PNG writing: OVITO/Tachyon cpk at final quality (16 ambient-occlusion samples, 16 Tachyon threads) takes 1.43 s per frame, i.e. ≈ 17 min for a 721-frame movie, the x-ray preset 1.27 s (≈ 15 min), the AO-free draft preset 0.26 s (≈ 3 min) and the numpy fallback renderer with 4 worker processes 0.24 s wall (≈ 3 min). The annotated vertical ticks mark the three production movies: 1028 s and 1031 s wall for render plus encode of the two cpk movies (1.43 s per frame, two coinciding ticks) and 896 s for the x-ray movie (1.24 s per frame).

numbers.cpu: 4 x Intel Xeon 2.10 GHz, no GPU
